entry.title: An Atiyah--Hirzebruch to Adams map and the hastened Adams spectral sequence for supercohomology
entry.summary:
We construct a map of filtered spectra inducing a map from the Atiyah--Hirzebruch spectral sequence (AHSS) to the Baker--Lazarev Adams spectral sequence of a $\mathit{ko}$-module $M$. Using this and a theorem of Bruner--Rognes, we construct a hastened Adams spectral sequence (HASS) for the Postnikov truncations of $\mathit{ko}$ and the connective Adams summand. Then, motivated by questions in quantum field theory, topological phases of matter, and tensor category theory, we apply the HASS to supercohomology, the cohomology theory $I_{\mathbb{C}^\times}(τ_{\le 2}\mathit{ko})$, and observe that in examples of interest it is easier to calculate with than either the AHSS or the usual Adams spectral sequence.

Source: arXiv Mathematics (NT, CO, AG, LO, AT, GR) · Tags: #number-theory #combinatorics #topology #high-energy

entry.title: Cameron--Martin theorem for SLE welding measures. For $κ\in(0,4]$, we prove a Cameron--Martin theorem for the welding law induced by SLE$_κ$ loop measure.
entry.summary:
For $κ\in(0,4]$, we prove a Cameron--Martin theorem for the welding law induced by SLE$_κ$ loop measure. Under simultaneous left and right composition $h\mapsto\varphi\circ h\circψ^{-1}$, the transformed law is mutually absolutely continuous with respect to the original law exactly when both maps belong to the Weil--Petersson group, and is mutually singular otherwise. Thus the Weil--Petersson group is the quasi-invariance group of the welding law under composition on either side.

Source: arXiv Mathematics (NT, CO, AG, LO, AT, GR) · Tags: #number-theory #combinatorics #probability-stats #logic

entry.title: Two almost sure upper bounds for sums of random multiplicative functions. Let $f,g$ be a squarefree and extended Rademacher random multiplicative functions, respectively.
entry.summary:
Let $f,g$ be a squarefree and extended Rademacher random multiplicative functions, respectively. We prove that, for every $\varepsilon>0$, almost surely $$\big|\sum_{n \le x}\frac{f(n)}{\sqrt{n}}\big| \ll (\log\log x)^{1/4+\varepsilon}, \qquad \big|\sum_{n\le x}g(n)\big|\ll\sqrt{x}(\log\log x)^{1/4+\varepsilon}.$$ We also show that almost surely, there exist arbitrarily large values of $x$ such that $\sum_{n \le x}\frac{f(n)}{\sqrt{n}} \gg (\log\log x)^{1/4+o(1)}$. We follow Caich and Durkan and Pearce-Crump by using a version of the Azuma--Hoeffding inequality for martingale difference sequences.

Source: arXiv Mathematics (NT, CO, AG, LO, AT, GR) · Tags: #number-theory #combinatorics #probability-stats

entry.title: On a Secretary Problem with Two Equal-Sized Pools of Candidates. This paper presents the solution of a secretary type problem where the decision maker observes a sequence of offers of two types.
entry.summary:
This paper presents the solution of a secretary type problem where the decision maker observes a sequence of offers of two types. There are N objects of both types and these objects appear to the decision maker in random order. Objects can only be compared when they are of the same type.

Source: arXiv Mathematics (NT, CO, AG, LO, AT, GR) · Tags: #number-theory #combinatorics #probability-stats #optimization
